role_grants_single_scope.name: role_grants_single_scope
role_grants_single_scope.value: not ("role_grants"."site_id" is not null and "role_grants"."department_id" is not null)

projects_dates_ck.name: projects_dates_ck
projects_dates_ck.value: "projects"."due_date" is null or "projects"."start_date" is null or "projects"."due_date" >= "projects"."start_date"

recurring_cadence_fields_ck.name: recurring_cadence_fields_ck
recurring_cadence_fields_ck.value: ("recurring_task_definitions"."cadence" <> 'WEEKLY' or "recurring_task_definitions"."weekday" between 0 and 6) and ("recurring_task_definitions"."cadence" <> 'MONTHLY' or "recurring_task_definitions"."month_day" between 1 and 28)

rules_approved_meta_ck.name: rules_approved_meta_ck
rules_approved_meta_ck.value: "license_policy_rules"."status" <> 'APPROVED' or ("license_policy_rules"."approved_by" is not null and "license_policy_rules"."approved_at" is not null and "license_policy_rules"."approval_reason" is not null)

authorities_verified_has_reviewer_ck.name: authorities_verified_has_reviewer_ck
authorities_verified_has_reviewer_ck.value: "professional_authorities"."status" <> 'VERIFIED' or ("professional_authorities"."verified_by" is not null and "professional_authorities"."verified_at" is not null)

enrollments_approved_dates_ck.name: enrollments_approved_dates_ck
enrollments_approved_dates_ck.value: "provider_enrollments"."status" <> 'APPROVED' or ("provider_enrollments"."approved_on" is not null and "provider_enrollments"."effective_on" is not null)

resource_reservations_owner_ck.name: resource_reservations_owner_ck
resource_reservations_owner_ck.value: ("resource_reservations"."reservation_kind" = 'APPOINTMENT' and "resource_reservations"."appointment_id" is not null) or ("resource_reservations"."reservation_kind" = 'HOLD' and "resource_reservations"."hold_id" is not null) or "resource_reservations"."reservation_kind" = 'BLOCK'

schedule_exceptions_target_ck.name: schedule_exceptions_target_ck
schedule_exceptions_target_ck.value: ("schedule_exceptions"."kind" = 'CLOSURE' and "schedule_exceptions"."site_id" is not null) or ("schedule_exceptions"."kind" <> 'CLOSURE' and "schedule_exceptions"."practitioner_id" is not null)

rcm_case_actions_actor_ck.name: rcm_case_actions_actor_ck
rcm_case_actions_actor_ck.value: ("rcm_case_actions"."actor_user_id" is not null) or ("rcm_case_actions"."actor_system" is not null)

compliance_items_approval_ck.name: compliance_items_approval_ck
compliance_items_approval_ck.value: "compliance_items"."status" <> 'APPROVED' or ("compliance_items"."approved_by" is not null and "compliance_items"."submitted_by" is not null and "compliance_items"."approved_by" <> "compliance_items"."submitted_by" and "compliance_items"."evidence_ref" is not null)
